offering_description.value: Designs, sources and sells replacement parts and fasteners for passenger cars, light trucks and heavy-duty vehicles, mainly 'problem-solver' parts the original manufacturer sold only as expensive assemblies. Sells to aftermarket retailers, parts distributors and wholesalers; products are largely made by contract manufacturers, mostly in Asia.

primary_products.value: automotive replacement parts; chassis and suspension components; fasteners and hardware; brake and fluid line components; heavy-duty truck parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: auto parts retailers, warehouse distributors, wholesalers and heavy-duty parts dealers

end_markets.value: automotive aftermarket; heavy-duty trucking; light vehicle repair

revenue_model.value: product sales: replacement vehicle parts and hardware sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and engineers parts made by contract manufacturers, sold under own brands to retailers and distributors; distributor: supplies fasteners and hardware from purchased stock to aftermarket customers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States and Canada, with sales in Europe and other regions, sourcing from Asia

specialization.value: related lines: light-duty parts, heavy-duty parts and specialty vehicle products sharing aftermarket channels

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: national auto parts retail chains; distributors / dealers: warehouse distributors, wholesalers and heavy-duty parts dealers; online: online auto parts retailers and marketplaces

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety, import tariffs and trade rules, environmental and emissions-related rules for vehicle parts
